name: Soybean Crush Spread — Processing Margin
description: CBOT board crush spread: value of soybean products (meal + oil) minus raw soybean cost. Formula: ZM×(44/2000) + ZL×(11/100) − ZS/100, giving $/bushel processing margin. Shows crush over time with 1Y moving average, monthly seasonal pattern, and extreme z-score event markers.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush
# Crush = ZM × (44/2000) + ZL × (11/100) − ZS / 100
# ZM = $/ton, ZL = ¢/lb, ZS = ¢/bu → result in $/bushel

# --- Data: Load all three legs with NoAdjustment (preserves cross-commodity ratios) ---
zs_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.ZS)()
zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()

zs = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)
zm = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)
zl = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ($/bushel) ---
# 1 bushel soybeans yields ~44 lbs meal + ~11 lbs oil
# ZM quoted $/short ton (2000 lbs), ZL quoted ¢/lb, ZS quoted ¢/bushel
meal_value = zm.c * 44.0 / 2000.0
oil_value = zl.c * 11.0 / 100.0
bean_cost = zs.c / 100.0
crush = meal_value + oil_value - bean_cost

# --- Moving Average & Z-Score ---
crush_ma_252 = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(crush)
crush_z = zscore(window=252)(crush)

# --- Date extraction for seasonality ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Extreme z-score events (crush unusually high or low) ---
crush_extreme_high = is_valid(crush_z) and crush_z > 2.0
crush_extreme_low = is_valid(crush_z) and crush_z < -2.0
is_extreme = crush_extreme_high or crush_extreme_low
extreme_label = conditional_select(crush_extreme_high, 'High', crush_extreme_low, 'Low', 'Normal')

# --- OUTPUT 1: Summary Stats (tables first per R10) ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Crush Spread',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Spread Key Metrics',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Current Level', 'Historical Median', 'Current Z-Score'],
        col_headers=['Value', 'Context'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Latest crush spread $/bu'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='1Y moving average'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='All-history median'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Historical std dev'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='Current z-score vs 1Y'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Total daily observations')
        ]
    ),
    order=0
)(crush, crush_ma_252, crush, crush, crush_z, crush)

# --- OUTPUT 2: Crush Spread Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Margin — Where Are Processing Profits?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='$/Bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1Y Moving Avg', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Breakeven', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush, crush_ma_252))

# --- OUTPUT 3: Monthly Seasonal Pattern ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='When Does the Crush Margin Typically Peak?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='Avg $/Bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Breakeven', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=crush, label=month_num)

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Extreme Crush Levels ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Crush Margin',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush ($/bu)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(crush, crush_z, extreme_label, is_extreme)
